_comment: Manual corrections applied by generate_calendar.py AFTER the parse. Since the 9.24.26 reissue the parser reads block ENDS from the PDF's drawn borders, so the old 'stretch this lab to 5 PM' entries are gone; what is left is only what the drawing cannot say -- today, the afternoon half of each OSCE #5 Full Case Management day (a tinted cell with no text of its own). Two entry shapes: {\"at\": \"HH:MM\", \"start\"?, \"end\"?} nudges an existing session; {\"clear\": \"HH:MM-HH:MM\", ...} replaces parsed fragments; a plain {start, end, label, ...} adds a block. EVERY entry should carry \"expect\": a phrase that must still be on that day, otherwise the entry is skipped with a warning rather than clobbering whatever the school moved there. Re-check all of these when the school reissues the schedule.
